description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Camille''' empowers her next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range, deal '''bonus''' physical damage and grant her [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed for 1 second. This attack cannot [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]].
description.text: Active: Camille empowers her next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  50 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and grant her  bonus movement speed for 1 second. This attack cannot critically strike.

description2.raw: After 0.<small>25</small> seconds of using the empowered attack, ''Precision Protocol'' can then be recast within the next 3.<small>5</small> seconds at no additional cost.
description2.text: After 0.25 seconds of using the empowered attack, Precision Protocol can then be recast within the next 3.5 seconds at no additional cost.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Camille''' mimics the first cast's effects. If ''Precision Protocol'' is recast after 1.5 seconds of the first attack, then the '''bonus''' damage is doubled, and 40% – 100% (based on level) of the attack's '''total''' damage will be dealt as [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage.
description3.text: Recast: Camille mimics the first cast's effects. If Precision Protocol is recast after 1.5 seconds of the first attack, then the bonus damage is doubled, and 40% – 100% (based on level) of the attack's total damage will be dealt as  true damage.

description4.raw: ''Both casts of Precision Protocol [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|reset]] '''Camille's''' basic attack timer. '''Camille''' is able to cast [[File:Camille Tactical Sweep.png|20xpx|border|link=Camille#Tactical Sweep|An icon for Camille's ability Tactical Sweep]] [[Camille#Tactical Sweep|Tactical Sweep]], [[File:Camille Hookshot.png|20xpx|border|link=Camille#Hookshot|An icon for Camille's ability Hookshot]] [[Camille#Hookshot|Hookshot]], or [[File:Camille The Hextech Ultimatum.png|20xpx|border|link=Camille#The Hextech Ultimatum|An icon for Camille's ability The Hextech Ultimatum]] [[Camille#The Hextech Ultimatum|The Hextech Ultimatum]] during the windup of Precision Protocol's empowered attack without cancelling it.''
description4.text: Both casts of Precision Protocol reset Camille's basic attack timer. Camille is able to cast Tactical Sweep, Hookshot, or The Hextech Ultimatum during the windup of Precision Protocol's empowered attack without cancelling it.

notes.raw: * Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * Both enhanced attacks '''cannot''' [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]]. * The 1.5-second delay is "fuzzy", meaning it may take up to another 0.25 seconds to ready the window for the empowered attack. ** This syncs up perfectly with [[File:Sheen item.png|20xpx|border|link=Sheen|An icon for the item Sheen]] [[Sheen|Sheen's]] cooldown between casts at 0 [[Haste#Item_haste|item haste]], which is also "fuzzy". * The second attack will also become empowered if it simply starts after the 1.5-second delay, even if the recast was consumed earlier. * The empowered '''recast''''s [[File:Hybrid penetration.png|20px|link=True damage|An icon representing the keyword True damage]] [[:True damage|true damage]]: ** Has a special case to factor [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] into the true damage conversion of part of her attack's damage. ** Other [[on-hit]] effects do not interact with the true damage conversion. ** Randomly dependent on buff order, if (e.g. [[File:Plated Steelcaps item.png|20xpx|border|link=Plated Steelcaps|An icon for the item Plated Steelcaps]] [[Plated Steelcaps|Plated Steelcaps']] [[Named item effect#Plating|Plating]], [[File:K'Sante Path Maker.png|20xpx|border|link=K'Sante#Path Maker|An icon for K'Sante's ability Path Maker]] [[K'Sante#Path Maker|Path Maker]]) applies first before the conversion, then the resulting damage will be reduced, otherwise if the conversion happens first, then the damage will not be successfully reduced (both effects are pre-mitigation on-take-damage events).(bug) ** Is dealt just prior to the physical damage portion of the attack. * ''Precision Protocol'' applies to [[structures]] but the recast does not convert to true damage. * The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] during the [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack's windup]]. * [[File:Warden's Mail item.png|20xpx|border|link=Warden's Mail|An icon for the item Warden's Mail]] [[Warden's Mail|Warden's Mail's]] flat damage reduction is reduced on the second cast, reducing the physical damage but not the true damage.(unexpected)
notes.text:
Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Both enhanced attacks cannot critically strike.
The 1.5-second delay is "fuzzy", meaning it may take up to another 0.25 seconds to ready the window for the empowered attack.
* This syncs up perfectly with Sheen's cooldown between casts at 0 item haste, which is also "fuzzy".
The second attack will also become empowered if it simply starts after the 1.5-second delay, even if the recast was consumed earlier.
The empowered recast's true damage:
* Has a special case to factor Spellblade into the true damage conversion of part of her attack's damage.
* Other on-hit effects do not interact with the true damage conversion.
* Randomly dependent on buff order, if (e.g. Plated Steelcaps' Plating, Path Maker) applies first before the conversion, then the resulting damage will be reduced, otherwise if the conversion happens first, then the damage will not be successfully reduced (both effects are pre-mitigation on-take-damage events).(bug)
* Is dealt just prior to the physical damage portion of the attack.
Precision Protocol applies to structures but the recast does not convert to true damage.
The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become untargetable during the attack's windup.
Warden's Mail's flat damage reduction is reduced on the second cast, reducing the physical damage but not the true damage.(unexpected)
